mentions.name: Rimpark
mentions.description: Rimpark is a multiplayer browser game launched about 1.5 years ago. Its gameplay is being improved with new mechanics and bug fixes, developed with the help of a self-hosted GLM 5.3 Flash model and an agentic coding system that implements features end-to-end with light human code review.
mentions.source_excerpt: Side hobby: Improving the gameplay of a multiplayer browser game. Rimpark (https://rimpark.gg) launched ~1.5y ago.
